name: Greater Holyoke YMCA Summer Program
description_short: Seven week YMCA day camp for ages 5 to 13 at the Holyoke YMCA, with a second site at Plains School in South Hadley. Each week has a theme, with swimming, sports, arts and crafts and field trips.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer 2026, seven themed weeks, full week enrollment only, 8:00 am to 5:30 pm. Two locations: Greater Holyoke YMCA (free lunch through the Holyoke Food Program) and Plains School in South Hadley (bring lunch, runs through Week 5 only). meals_included refers to the Holyoke site. Financial assistance by scholarship form. Week dates and prices are not on the page.

source.title: Summer Camp 2026 | Greater Holyoke YMCA & South Hadley
